A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the infrared divergent loop diagrams are not a mere technical issue, but they are a physical manifestation of a breakdown of perturbation theory.

the infrared divergent contribution from the entropy mode loops is larger than the usual expectation in the literature, and the infrared divergent entropy mode loops can be the main source of infrared divergence in the curvature power spectrum.
, if one wants to use the standard effective field theory of inflationary cosmology, the coupling constant of the self-interactions of entropy modes must be smaller than a certain critical value.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the entropy fluctuations are important in determining the validity of the perturbation theory of inflation.
the infrared divergent loop corrections are more severe than previously thought and that this may lead to an instability in de Sitter space.
in order to make reliable statements about the stability of inflationary spacetimes one needs to include the effects of entropy perturbations, which is in general a non-trivial task.
